common_ground.text: Mainnet activation should rest on community support; Shielded Labs says it will not push for activation without it.
The feature net software has been rough: crashes, sync problems and stalled finality.

output.headline: Shielded Labs' paid Crosslink test network: need for backing, stalls, and a disputed Round 1 payout
output.next: Round 3 runs on a new feature net (v14); the original roadmap targets an upgrade-candidate network in Q1 2027.

unresolved.text: Will alphiz22's Round 1 claim be paid? Shielded Labs was checking whether the ZingoDelegator build explains the unreadable transactions; no outcome is posted.
What caused the multi-hour Round 2 stall, with BFT peers dropping from 25-26 to 1, and how did it end? No reply is recorded.
Will stake gather around a few well-known finalizers, and does the Protocol Guardian design counter that? Replies only covered how to join.

best_against.quote: I posted this mainly because the pause lasted almost 3 hours while PoW continued by about 558 blocks, with PoS Height remaining at 124901 and PoW Finalized remaining at 655350 the entire time.

best_for.quote: Rather than risking transaction rollbacks, a protocol will halt finalization if it can no longer safely reach consensus, choosing safety over availability.

views.label: Finality stalls are expected; work through them live
views.one_line: A BFT system halts finality rather than risk rollbacks, so stalls are normal on a feature net. Work through them live and build tools instead of resetting.

best_against.quote: Given the amount of effort and resources being put into Crosslink (I presume Shielded Labs primary focus is Crosslink dev). I’d recommend obtaining strong signals and support for this.

best_for.quote: Spinning up a testnet should be permissionless and a standard part of proposing a feature for mainnet inclusion. It should not require approval from coinholders or community panels.

views.label: Feature nets need no prior approval
views.one_line: A testnet should be permissionless and needs no coinholder or panel approval. It gives the community a working product to judge, and mainnet still needs support.

best_against.quote: Testnets give the community something tangible to evaluate rather than an abstract idea, and provide a way for users to actually use and understand how a feature works before forming an opinion.

best_for.quote: Given the amount of effort and resources being put into Crosslink (I presume Shielded Labs primary focus is Crosslink dev). I’d recommend obtaining strong signals and support for this.

views.label: Get strong community support first
views.one_line: Given the effort and resources going into Crosslink, Shielded Labs should obtain strong signals and support for it.

output.why_it_matters: Shielded Labs pays real ZEC (25 ZEC per round) to test Crosslink, a proposed Zcash finality upgrade. Mainnet activation would still need community consensus.
